players.name: James Conner
players.summary: Conner (foot) isn't yet doing full-team drills at training camp, Darren Urban of azcardinals.com reports.

players.name: Michael Penix Jr.
players.summary: Penix (knee) still hasn't been cleared for 11-on-11s and won't be available for Friday's preseason opener against Denver, Josh Kendall of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Tyrell Shavers
players.summary: The Bills placed Shavers (knee) on the active/PUP list Tuesday, Matt Parrino of The Syracuse Post-Standard reports.

players.name: Darren Waller
players.summary: The Panthers signed Waller (groin) to a one-year contract Wednesday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

players.name: Josh Kattus
players.summary: The Bengals activated Kattus (undisclosed) off the active/non-football injury list Thursday.

players.name: KC Concepcion
players.summary: Concepcion said Friday that his shoulder has felt fine since returning to practice earlier this week, Mary Kay Cabot of The Cleveland Plain Dealer reports.

players.name: Princeton Fant
players.summary: The Cowboys placed Fant (knee) on injured reserve Thursday.

players.name: Caleb Lohner
players.summary: Lohner (lower body) does not yet have a return timeline, Luca Evans of The Denver Post reports.

players.name: Sione Vaki
players.summary: Vaki suffered a broken nose in Monday's practice, Justin Rogers of DetroitFootball.net reports.

players.name: Tucker Kraft
players.summary: Kraft (knee) ran routes on air in full pads while catching passes from QB Jordan Love at Monday's practice, Ryan Wood of USA Today reports.

players.name: Tank Dell
players.summary: Dell (knee) participated in "full-team drills" Monday, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

players.name: Alec Pierce
players.summary: Pierce (ankle) was present for Tuesday's practice and took part in individual work off to the side under the supervision of a trainer, James Boyd of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Xavier Worthy
players.summary: Worthy (shoulder) will take part in Monday's practice, Pete Sweeney of The Kansas City Star reports.

players.name: Patrick Mahomes
players.summary: Chiefs coach Andy Reid said Friday that Mahomes (knee) is unlikely to play in the Chiefs' preseason opener against the Rams on Saturday, Aug. 15, Sam McDowell of The Kansas City Star reports.

players.name: John Michael Gyllenborg
players.summary: The Chiefs placed Gyllenborg (knee) on injured reserve Tuesday, Matt Derrick of ChiefsDigest.com reports.

players.name: Chris Collier
players.summary: Collier (undisclosed) reverted to injured reserve with the Raiders on Sunday, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Chris Bell
players.summary: Dolphins coach Jeff Hafley suggested Friday that Bell (knee) might have a chance to play this preseason, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

players.name: Jimmy Kibble
players.summary: Kibble (undisclosed) reverted to New England's injured reserve Friday.

players.name: Jeremiah Webb
players.summary: The Patriots placed Webb (arm) on injured reserve Sunday, Evan Lazar of the team's official site reports.

players.name: Malik Nabers
players.summary: Coach John Harbaugh said Wednesday that Nabers (knee) may mix into team drills as early as next week, Pat Leonard of the New York Daily News reports.

players.name: Beaux Collins
players.summary: Collins (concussion) reverted to the Giants' injured reserve Thursday, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

players.name: Makai Lemon
players.summary: Lemon (hamstring) won't take part in Thursday's practice, Eliot Shorr-Parks of Sports Radio 94 WIP Philadelphia reports.

players.name: Ricky Pearsall
players.summary: Pearsall announced Thursday in a post on his personal Instagram account that he underwent season-ending surgery to repair the PCL in his right knee, David Lombardi of SFStandard.com reports.

players.name: Mike Evans
players.summary: Evans (quadriceps) is in pads and taking part in warmups ahead of Tuesday's joint practice with the Titans, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: George Kittle
players.summary: Kittle (Achilles) was seen running routes, catching passes and doing conditioning work prior to Monday's practice, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Christian Kirk
players.summary: Kirk (calf) remained sidelined at Saturday's practice, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: De'Zhaun Stribling
players.summary: Stribling (hamstring) participated in 11-on-11 team drills during Saturday's training camp practice, Noah Furtado of the San Francisco Chronicle reports.

players.name: Kaelon Black
players.summary: Black is missing Monday's practice due to an adductor injury, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Jake Bobo
players.summary: Bobo (hamstring) was a full participant in Monday's practice, Corbin K. Smith of SI.com reports.

players.name: Zach Charbonnet
players.summary: The Seahawks have placed Charbonnet (knee) on the physically unable to perform list ahead of training camp, John Boyle of the team's official site reports.

players.name: John Bates
players.summary: Bates will miss "a couple of weeks" due to a hamstring injury, Ben Standig of Big 100 Washington D.C. reports.
